verdict_text: YES — the script produces exactly what the specification requires. `keep_index(1, 2048, 128)` yields `arange(0,640)` concatenated with `arange(768,2048)`, matching the "keep rows/columns `0..639`, `768..2047`, in that order" requirement; it is applied along dim 0 for q/k/v and dim 1 for o_proj, for all 16 layers, leaving every other tensor untouched.
